body:
Every new line is converted to a "paragraph" as far as the class reference is concerned. Empty new lines are not necessary and will likely cause the static checks to fail.

There's actually a way to join new lines such that the separation by paragraph doesn't happen, using `[br]`, but that is rarely ever used in the class reference (only by yours truly in `Array.xml`)
